        df_latest.groupby('plan')['seats']
        .mean()
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values('seats', ascending=False)
        .head(10)
    )
    result['segments'].append({
        "segment_column": "plan",
        "metric_column": "seats",
        "aggregation": "mean",
        "results": [{"name": str(row['plan']), "value": float(row['seats'])} for _, row in seg_seats_plan_mean.iterrows()]

    seg_count_plan = (
        df_latest.groupby('plan')['account_id']
        .count()
        .reset_index()
        .rename(columns={'account_id': 'count'})
        .sort_values('count', ascending=False)
        .head(10)
    )
    result['segments'].append({
        "segment_column": "plan",
        "metric_column": "account_id",
        "aggregation": "count",
        "results": [{"name": str(row['plan']), "value": float(row['count'])} for _, row in seg_count_plan.iterrows()]

        df_latest.groupby('plan')['churned']
        .mean()
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values('churned', ascending=False)
        .head(10)
    )
    result['segments'].append({
        "segment_column": "plan",
        "metric_column": "churned",
        "aggregation": "mean",
        "results": [{"name": str(row['plan']), "value": float(row['churned'])} for _, row in seg_churn_plan.iterrows()]
    })

    # mrr sum by plan at latest month
    seg_mrr_plan = (
        df_latest.groupby('plan')['mrr']
        .sum()
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values('mrr', ascending=False)
        .head(10)
    )
    result['segments'].append({
        "segment_column": "plan",
        "metric_column": "mrr",
        "aggregation": "sum",
        "results": [{"name": str(row['plan']), "value": float(row['mrr'])} for _, row in seg_mrr_plan.iterrows()]
    })

    # active_users sum by plan at latest month
    seg_au_plan = (
        df_latest.groupby('plan')['active_users']
        .sum()
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values('active_users', ascending=False)
        .head(10)
    )
    result['segments'].append({
        "segment_column": "plan",
        "metric_column": "active_users",
        "aggregation": "sum",
        "results": [{"name": str(row['plan']), "value": float(row['active_users'])} for _, row in seg_au_plan.iterrows()]
    })

    result['assumptions'].append("Segmentation uses each account's last record at the latest month as a snapshot to avoid double-counting levels.")
    result['assumptions'].append("churned is averaged (rate) per plan; mrr, seats, active_users are summed per plan at latest month.")

except Exception as e:
